l8.title: ALSVID L1 · Carbon folding e-bike
l8.description: Meet ALSVID L1: a 20-inch carbon folding e-bike concept with torque-sensing assistance and four-bar rear suspension. Explore the reference configuration.
l8.headline: City rhythm. Smaller footprint.
l8.intro: A carbon frame, 20-inch wheels and a folding silhouette. L1 brings electric assistance and rear suspension into a compact urban format.
l8.photo.note: Retouched reference images with cleaned backgrounds and branding removed. Final colour, finish and equipment depend on the confirmed product.
l8.gallery.label: L1 reference photographs
l8.gallery.side.alt: L1 reference bike in side view, with a carbon folding frame and chain drivetrain
l8.gallery.folded.alt: L1 reference bike folded, viewed from the front
l8.design.title: One compact form. Three considered details.
l8.carbon.title: Carbon at the core.
l8.carbon.body: The reference frame and fork use carbon fibre, with a central hinge that allows the bicycle to fold for storage.
l8.assist.title: Assistance that follows your pedals.
l8.assist.body: A torque sensor measures your pedalling input and controls the SHENGYI rear-hub motor. The reference configuration delivers up to {torque} Nm.
l8.suspension.title: Room for a softer ride.
l8.suspension.body: A four-bar rear linkage works with a DNM air shock. The suspension mechanism is separate from the main-frame folding hinge.
l8.fold.kicker: Make space for what comes next
l8.fold.title: Ride. Fold. Put it away.
l8.fold.body: The frame and handlebar fold into a smaller shape for storage between rides. The photograph shows the folded reference bike; final dimensions and measured weight will be published with the confirmed ALSVID build.
l8.spec.title: The details, clearly stated.
l8.spec.note: These specifications describe the manufacturer's reference configuration, not a confirmed ALSVID production build.
l8.spec.range.value: Over {range} km pedal-assist reference; configuration and use dependent
l8.spec.load.value: {load} kg manufacturer product specification; not an independent whole-bike load-test result
l8.available.title: A first look. More details to follow.
l8.available.body: This model is available by reservation only; no stock is available. The reservation lead time is four months. Final ALSVID configuration and pricing will be announced officially.
l8.launch.body: Discover a different kind of compact: carbon construction, electric assistance and four-bar rear suspension.
